senses.d: A structure built for commemorative or symbolic reasons, or as a memorial; a commemoration.
ex: There is a monument on the town green to the soldiers who died in World War I.

senses.d: An important site owned by the community as a whole.
a registered archaeological site or other structure, deemed historic or otherwise worthy of protection.
A sign of exceptional achievement.
ex: The line became a monument to his drive and imagination — and a hard training course for the future chief of the Great Central.

senses.d: An important burial vault or tomb.

A pile of stones left by a prospector to claim ownership of ore etc. found in a mine.

To mark or memorialize with a monument.
To place a surveyor's monument at.
